title: Recursive pass — Hsiao Data Frontiers successor roster depth 5
summary: Resolves the exact March 2023-December 2024 and March 2025-December 2026 network calendars, finds bounded discontinuity for Hsiao on the current Data Frontiers roster, and selects max-depth chronology synthesis.

sources.title: Network of Global Future Councils — 2023-2024 term
Global Future Council on Data Frontiers

data.research_question: Does the exact term calendar and successor roster close the post-Data Equity chronology?
data.method: Official WEF network-term pages plus current successor roster crossmatch.
classification_rules: Exact network dates supersede weaker inferred term bounds.
Roster absence is bounded to the named official roster.
Max-depth synthesis must preserve unresolved person-level dates.

findings.finding: The 2023-24 GFC term ran March 2023 through December 2024; the current term runs March 2025 through December 2026.
Hsiao is not listed on the current Data Frontiers roster, although several Data Equity members carry over.
